The '''Latza system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Spirva sector/Legends|Spirva sector]], in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Latza VII]].
